# 13.1 Getting Started

```{r}
pacman::p_load(olsrr, corrplot, ggpubr, 
               sf, sfdep, GWmodel, tmap, 
               tidyverse, gtsummary,
               performance, see, RColorBrewer)
```

# 13.2 Geospatial Data Wrangling

## 13.2.1 Importing geospatial data

```{r}
mpsz = st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", 
               layer = "MP14_SUBZONE_WEB_PL")
```

## 13.2.2 Updating CRS information

```{r}
mpsz_svy21 <- st_transform(mpsz, 3414)
```

```{r}
st_crs(mpsz_svy21)
```

```{r}
st_bbox(mpsz_svy21)
```

# 13.3 Aspatial Data Wrangling

## 13.3.1 Importing the aspatial data

```{r}
condo_resale = read_csv("data/aspatial/Condo_resale_2015.csv")
```

```{r}
glimpse(condo_resale)
```

```{r}
head(condo_resale$LONGITUDE)
```

```{r}
head(condo_resale$LATITUDE)
```

```{r}
summary(condo_resale)
```

## 13.3.2 Converting aspatial data frame into a sf object

```{r}
condo_resale.sf <- st_as_sf(condo_resale,
                            coords = c("LONGITUDE", "LATITUDE"),
                            crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)
```

```{r}
head(condo_resale.sf)
```


```{r}
condo_resale.sf <- condo_resale.sf %>%
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = condo_resale.sf,
```

# 13.5 Hedonic Pricing Modelling in R

## 13.5.1 Simple Linear Regression Method

```{r}
condo.slr <- lm(formula = SELLING_PRICE ~ AREA_SQM, 
                data = condo_resale.sf)
```

```{r}
summary(condo.slr)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = condo_resale.sf,  
       aes(x = `AREA_SQM`, y = `SELLING_PRICE`)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = lm)
```

## 13.5.2 Multiple Linear Regression Method

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10
corrplot(cor(condo_resale[, 5:23]), 
         diag = FALSE, 
         order = "AOE",
         tl.pos = "td", 
         tl.cex = 0.5, 
         method = "number", 
         type = "upper")
```

## 13.5.3 Building a hedonic pricing model using multiple linear regression method

```{r}
condo.mlr <- lm(
  formula = SELLING_PRICE ~ AREA_SQM + AGE + 
    PROX_CBD + PROX_CHILDCARE + PROX_ELDERLYCARE +
    PROX_URA_GROWTH_AREA + PROX_HAWKER_MARKET +
    PROX_KINDERGARTEN + PROX_MRT + PROX_PARK +
    PROX_PRIMARY_SCH + PROX_TOP_PRIMARY_SCH +
    PROX_SHOPPING_MALL + PROX_SUPERMARKET + 
    PROX_BUS_STOP + NO_Of_UNITS + 
    FAMILY_FRIENDLY + FREEHOLD, 
  data = condo_resale.sf)
summary(condo.mlr)
```

## 13.5.4 Revising the model

```{r}
condo.mlr1 <- lm(
  formula = SELLING_PRICE ~ AREA_SQM + AGE + 
    PROX_CBD + PROX_CHILDCARE + PROX_MRT +
    PROX_ELDERLYCARE + PROX_URA_GROWTH_AREA +
    PROX_PARK + PROX_PRIMARY_SCH + 
    PROX_SHOPPING_MALL + PROX_BUS_STOP + 
    NO_Of_UNITS + FAMILY_FRIENDLY + FREEHOLD,
  data = condo_resale.sf)
summary(condo.mlr1)
```

## 13.5.5 Preparing Publication Quality Table: gtsummary method

```{r}
tbl_regression(condo.mlr1, intercept = TRUE)
```

```{r}
tbl_regression(condo.mlr1, 
               intercept = TRUE) %>% 
  add_glance_source_note(
    label = list(sigma ~ "\U03C3"),
    include = c(r.squared, adj.r.squared, 
                AIC, statistic,
                p.value, sigma))
```

## 13.5.6 Regression Diagnostics

### Checking for multicollinearity

```{r}
check_collinearity(condo.mlr1)
```

```{r}
mlr.vif <- check_collinearity(condo.mlr1)
plot(mlr.vif)
```

### Test for non-linearity

```{r}
check_model(condo.mlr1,
            check = "linearity")
```

### Test for normality assumption

```{r}
check_normality(condo.mlr1)
```

```{r}
plot(check_normality(condo.mlr1), 
     type = "qq")
```

```{r}
check_model(condo.mlr1,
            check = "normality")
```

### Testing for spatial autocorrelation

```{r}
mlr.output <- as.data.frame(condo.mlr1$residuals)
```

```{r}
condo_resale.sf <- cbind(condo_resale.sf, 
                         condo.mlr1$residuals) %>%
  rename(`MLR_RES` = `condo.mlr1.residuals`)
```

```{r}
tmap_mode("plot")
```

```{r}
tm_shape(mpsz_svy21) +
  tm_polygons(fill_alpha = 0.4) +
tm_shape(condo_resale.sf) +  
  tm_dots(
    fill = "MLR_RES",
    size = 0.7,
    col = "black",
    fill.scale = tm_scale(
      n = 10,
      values = rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")),
      style = "quantile",
      midpoint = NA),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Residuals")) + 
  tm_title("LM Residuals (Quantile Classification)") +
  tm_layout(legend.outside = TRUE) +
  tm_view(set_zoom_limits = c(11, 14))
```

```{r}
tmap_mode("plot")
```

```{r}
condo_resale.sf <- condo_resale.sf %>% 
  mutate(
    nb = st_dist_band(st_geometry(geometry), 
                      upper = 1500),
    wt = st_weights(nb, style = "W"),
    .before = 1) 
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
set.seed(1234)
global_moran_perm(
  condo_resale.sf$MLR_RES, 
  nb = condo_resale.sf$nb, 
  wt = condo_resale.sf$wt,
  alternative = "two.sided", 
  nsim = 499)
```

# 13.6 Building Hedonic Pricing Models using GWmodel

## 13.6.1 Building Fixed Bandwidth GWR Model

```{r}
#| cache: true
bw.fixed <- bw.gwr(
  formula = SELLING_PRICE ~ AREA_SQM + AGE + 
    PROX_CBD + PROX_CHILDCARE + PROX_ELDERLYCARE +
    PROX_URA_GROWTH_AREA + PROX_MRT + PROX_PARK + 
    PROX_PRIMARY_SCH + PROX_SHOPPING_MALL + 
    PROX_BUS_STOP + NO_Of_UNITS + FAMILY_FRIENDLY + 
    FREEHOLD, 
  data = condo_resale.sf, 
  approach = "CV", 
  kernel = "gaussian", 
  adaptive = FALSE, 
  longlat = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
gwr.fixed <- gwr.basic(
  formula = SELLING_PRICE ~ AREA_SQM + AGE + 
    PROX_CBD + PROX_CHILDCARE + PROX_ELDERLYCARE +
    PROX_URA_GROWTH_AREA + PROX_MRT + PROX_PARK +
    PROX_PRIMARY_SCH + PROX_SHOPPING_MALL + 
    PROX_BUS_STOP + NO_Of_UNITS + FAMILY_FRIENDLY + 
    FREEHOLD, 
  data = condo_resale.sf, 
  bw = bw.fixed, 
  kernel = "gaussian", 
  longlat = FALSE)
```

```{r}
gwr.fixed
```

## 13.6.2 Building Adaptive Bandwidth GWR Model

```{r}
#| cache: true
bw.adaptive <- bw.gwr(
  formula = SELLING_PRICE ~ AREA_SQM + AGE + 
    PROX_CBD + PROX_CHILDCARE + PROX_ELDERLYCARE +
    PROX_URA_GROWTH_AREA + PROX_MRT + PROX_PARK +
    PROX_PRIMARY_SCH + PROX_SHOPPING_MALL + 
    PROX_BUS_STOP + NO_Of_UNITS + 
    FAMILY_FRIENDLY + FREEHOLD, 
  data = condo_resale.sf, 
  approach = "CV", 
  kernel = "gaussian", 
  adaptive = TRUE, 
  longlat = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
gwr.adaptive <- gwr.basic(
  formula = SELLING_PRICE ~ AREA_SQM + AGE + 
    PROX_CBD + PROX_CHILDCARE + PROX_ELDERLYCARE +
    PROX_URA_GROWTH_AREA + PROX_MRT + PROX_PARK +
    PROX_PRIMARY_SCH + PROX_SHOPPING_MALL + PROX_BUS_STOP +
    NO_Of_UNITS + FAMILY_FRIENDLY + FREEHOLD,
  data = condo_resale.sf, 
  bw = bw.adaptive, 
  kernel = "gaussian", 
  adaptive = TRUE, 
  longlat = FALSE)
```

```{r}
gwr.adaptive
```

## 13.6.3 Converting SDF into sf data.frame


```{r}

```


# What I Learned

This exercise built a hedonic pricing model for condominium resale prices in Singapore, starting with a global multiple linear regression and then calibrating geographically weighted regression (GWR) models with GWmodel. The global model explained about 65% of the variation in price, but the residuals showed significant spatial autocorrelation under a Moran's I permutation test, which indicates that the relationship between price and its drivers is not constant across space. GWR addressed this by estimating a separate set of coefficients at each location, and the adaptive-bandwidth model raised the adjusted R-squared to roughly 0.86 while letting the effect of factors such as floor area, proximity to the CBD or MRT vary by neighbourhood. Along the way I learned to check regression assumptions with the performance package, including multicollinearity, linearity and normality of residuals, and to map local R-squared and coefficient estimates to see where the model fits well and where each variable matters most.
